ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَذْرُوهُ is in the derivative form: تَذْرُو
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ذ/ر/و–ي dh–r–w/y summit, top
; to cause to multiply, to create; to scatter, to blow away, to winnow; shelter, to shelter.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تَذْرُو tadhrū; ذَرْوٌ dharw and ذَارِيَاتٌ dhāriyāt.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَذْرُو tadhrū [imperf. of v. ذَرَا dharā, trans.] to scatter something, to blow away

(18:45) فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ and becomes dry stubble that the winds blow away.

entries.label: ذَارِيَاتٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ذَارِيَاتٌ dhāriyāt [pl. of act. part. fem.ذَارِيَة dhāriyatun] that which scatters, that which blows away

(51:1) وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا by those [winds] that scatter far and wide; * الذَّارِيَاتِ name of Sura 51, Meccan sura, so‐named because of the reference in verse

1 to ‘the Scattering Winds’ as a sign in nature illustrating the coming of the Day of Resurrection.

entries.label: ذَرْوٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ذَرْوٌ dharw [v. n.] scattering, dispersing, the act of blowing away

(51:1) وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا by those [winds] that scatter far and wide.
